'''Danny and the Droids''' was the opening act for [[The Rolling Droids]], a mechanical [[Band/Legends|band]]. Their biggest hit was "[[I Wanna Weld Your Hand]],"<ref name="Slugthrowers">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> which had a [[roboto]] intro and played on [[K-DROID]],<ref name="Star Tours" /> a station that played Top 40 [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Music/Legends|music]].<ref name="Complete Guide to Star Tours">''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]''</ref>
